schema.venue: Venue owns vendors and food items. Unique slug. Status ACTIVE/HIDDEN/ARCHIVED/SUSPENDED.
schema.vendor: Vendor is the stand/concept. Unique (venueId, slug). Required section and location strings exist but are often copied from CSV section text.

foodItem.activation: Hide rather than delete: EntityStatus ACTIVE/HIDDEN/ARCHIVED/SUSPENDED. availabilityStatus is separate.
foodItem.seasonFlags: isNewThisSeason and seasonIntroduced exist. Current NFL import set isNewThisSeason=true on nearly every item; this is an import flag, not independent 2026-new confirmation.
foodItem.location: FoodItem.location is a string. FoodItem.sections is a string array. Vendor.section and Vendor.location also exist.
foodItem.provenance: No dedicated source table. Provenance is tags such as import-source, Import, import-season:2026, NFL. lastConfirmed is usually null.
foodItem.dedupe: No alias table. Dedupe is unique (venueId, slug) plus name matching. Same product can exist as vendor-name-as-item and as a real SKU.
foodItem.price: basePrice optional. Most NFL import rows have null prices.

methodology.principle: Do not scrape only the prior NFL headline CSV. Multi-source, official-first. Failure to find an item is not discontinuation.
methodology.discontinuedRule: POSSIBLY_DISCONTINUED only with positive 2026 evidence (official inaugural menu omission, replaced concept, or explicit discontinuation). Not used for 'not found'.

confidence.HIGH: Official stadium/team/operator/vendor source clearly identifies the item
confidence.MEDIUM: Credible local media or operator-attributed trade press

limitations: This is a first-pass reconciliation, not a complete SKU census of every stand at 38 venues.
Nissan official directory fetch truncated after Little Caesars; additional stands likely remain on that page.
Lambeau PDF is a full official index; only representative SKUs were reconciled, not every beer/soda row.
International venues often publish club-matchday F&B, not NFL-overlay menus.
Prior Stadium Slop NFL data is dominated by data/league-import/nfl-venues-import.cleaned.csv headline/partner rows.
